readings: For each circuit country, average the drivers' wins in the standings at each race held there, then average those race figures across the country's races. Which countries are above the average across countries? Among those, which are also above the average of that above-average group? For each, give the country, its average wins, how far it is above the overall average, and how far it is above the group average.
queries:
WITH race_averages AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS average_wins
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM race_averages
    GROUP BY country
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM country_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ca.country, ca.average_wins
    FROM country_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ca.average_wins > o.average_wins
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.country,
       aa.average_wins,
       aa.average_wins - o.average_wins AS above_overall_average,
       aa.average_wins - ga.average_wins AS above_group_average
FROM above_average AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
WHERE aa.average_wins > ga.average_wins
